subject: Game System
text: Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest features a reduced two character party system, the ability to have the 2nd character act automatically, and the ability to save anywhere and retry battles.

evidence.quote: Such simplifications includes a reduced two character party system, the ability to have the 2nd character act automatically, and the ability to save anywhere and retry battles.

subject: Brown chests
text: Brown chests reset and can be looted again by exiting and re-entering an area, allowing a full stock of healing items.

evidence.quote: Brown chests reset and can be looted again by exiting and re-entering an area. This allows you to always keep a full stock of healing items on hand.

subject: Optional chest achievements
text: All optional chest achievements must be completed without leaving the area.

evidence.quote: Worth noting is that all optional chest achievements must be completed without leaving the area.

subject: Monsters
text: Monsters respawn upon exiting and re-entering an area and can be used to grind levels.

evidence.quote: Monsters also respawn upon exiting and re-entering and can be use to grind levels if needed.

subject: Red Chests
text: Red Chests contain equipment upgrades and spells; be sure to save before opening them if going for the Illiterate achievement.

evidence.quote: Red Chests contain equipment upgrades and spells. Be sure to save before opening if going for the Illiterate [achievement 449400] achievement and not referencing a guide.

subject: Equipment upgrades
text: Equipment upgrades provide a boost to stats and protection against status ailments.

evidence.quote: In general, it's worth picking up all equipment upgrades as you progress as they provide not only a boost to your stats but protection against status ailments.

subject: Defend
text: The Defend command causes the party member defending to take attacks directed at the character they are covering.

evidence.quote: The "Defend" command causes the party member defending to take the attacks directed at the character they are covering.

subject: Life magic
text: Life magic revives a party member and provides a full heal regardless of status.

evidence.quote: Life magic both revives a party member but also provides a full heal regardless of status.

subject: Weapons
text: Swords hit switches, axes cut trees, claws climb some walls, and bombs destroy breakable walls.

evidence.quote: Swords can be used to hit swtiches, axes can cut trees, claws can be used to climb some walls, and bombs can be used to destroy breakable walls.

subject: Allies
text: Only Benjamin gains experience throughout the quest, while allies join and remain at fixed levels.

evidence.quote: Only Benjamin will gain experience throughout the quest and allies will join and remain at fixed levels.

subject: Illiterate
text: Playing without magic requires heavier reliance on the Defend command because you rely on allies to heal in battle with their magic supply.

evidence.quote: In particular you will be relying more heavily on the "Defend" command as you are reliant on your allies to heal in battle with their magic supply.

subject: Illiterate
text: Illiterate interferes with The Bright Side because the player is locked out of the Heal spell after obtaining the second crystal.

evidence.quote: This achievement also interferes with The Bright Side (10) [achievement 449365] which is also missable as you get locked out of the Heal Spell after obtaining the second crystal.

subject: Steel Sword
text: Steel Sword is starting equipment.

evidence.quote: * Steel Sword - Starting equipment

subject: Steel Armor
text: Steel Armor is starting equipment.

evidence.quote: * Steel Armor - Starting equipment

subject: Steel Shield
text: Steel Shield is found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B1 and can no longer be obtained after getting Jumbo Bombs.

evidence.quote: * Steel Shield **(Missable)** - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B1 (Can no longer be obtained after getting Jumbo Bombs in the next section)

subject: Charm
text: Charm is obtained from a Battlefield west of the Sand Temple.

evidence.quote: * Charm - Obtained from a Battlefield west of the Sand Temple

subject: Cure
text: Cure spell is found in a chest in Foresta.

evidence.quote: * Cure - Found in a chest in Foresta

subject: Quake
text: Quake spell is found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B2.

evidence.quote: * Quake - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B2

subject: Fire
text: Fire spell is found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F.

evidence.quote: * Fire - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F

subject: Behemoth
text: Hill of Destiny consists of exposition and a boss fight against a Behemoth.

evidence.quote: This area is linear and just consists of some exposition and a boss fight against a Behemoth. Not much to do here besides attack until it's dead and move on.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli meets you in Foresta equipped with an axe and Life magic.

evidence.quote: Here you'll meet your first ally, Kaeli. She comes equipped with the axe we need to progress through the forest as well as Life magic.

subject: Minotaur
text: Progress through Level Forest and defeat the Minotaur at the end by trying the Life spell.

evidence.quote: Progress through the forest and defeat the Minotaur at the end (Try the Life spell).

subject: No Grinding Allowed
text: Avoid extra encounters in Level Forest to avoid over-leveling if going for the No Grinding Allowed achievement.

evidence.quote: Avoid extra encounters to avoid over-leveling if you are going for No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133].

subject: Axe
text: Upon finishing the Minotaur fight, Kaeli leaves the party and gifts her axe, allowing you to cut down trees.

evidence.quote: Upon finishing the fight, Kaeli will leave the party and gift you her axe. You can now cut down trees.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam joins at the Sand Temple equipped with bombs and access to Life magic.

evidence.quote: You will be joined by Tristam at this point as well. He is equipped with bombs and has access to Life magic.

subject: Charm
text: The Battlefield west of the Sand Temple provides Charm equipment and can be skipped and returned to later if going for No Grinding Allowed.

evidence.quote: The Battlefield west of the Sand Temple provides you with the Charm equipment which provides a small defense boost. Skip this and return later if you are going for No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]

subject: Bomb
text: Halfway through the Bone Dungeon, Tristam gives you access to bombs.

evidence.quote: Half way through you will be given access to bombs from Tristam.

subject: Steel Armor
text: Make sure you pick up the Steel Armor on your first run through Bone Dungeon as it becomes missable once you get the next level of bombs.

evidence.quote: Make sure you pick up the Steel Armor on your first run through as well as it becomes missable once you get the next level of bombs.

subject: Sand Coin
text: Defeating Flamerus Rex grants the Sand Coin, the Crystal of Earth, and the Elixir to heal Kaeli.

evidence.quote: Defeating the boss of the area, Flamerus Rex, will grant you the Sand Coin and the Crystal of Earth restoring life to the region. You will also be given the Elixir to heal Kaili.

subject: Flamerus Rex
text: Beating Flamerus Rex before reaching level 5 is required for the missable No Grinding Allowed achievement.

evidence.quote: No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]...Defeat Flamerus Rex before reaching level 5. **(Missable)**

subject: Kaeli
text: Return the Elixir to Kaeli in Foresta and continue on.

evidence.quote: Return the Elixir to Kaeli and continue on.

subject: Sand Coin
text: Coins unlock doors to new regions in Focus Tower, and the Sand Coin lets you travel up the tower to the next area.

evidence.quote: You will receive coins in your travels that will unlock the doors to new regions (Like the Sand Coin from the Bone Dungeon). The Sand Coin will let you travel up the tower to the next area.

subject: Knight's Sword
text: Knight's Sword is found in a chest in Ice Pyramid B1.

evidence.quote: * Knight's Sword - Found in a chest in Ice Pyramid B1

subject: Cat Claw

evidence.quote: * Cat Claw - Given by Phoebe in the Wintry Cave

subject: Jumbo Bomb

evidence.quote: * Jumbo Bomb - Given by Phoebe in Falls Basin

subject: Noble Armor

evidence.quote: * Noble Armor - Found in a chest in Ice Pyramid 4F

subject: Exit

subject: Blizzard

text: Phoebe joins at the Libra Temple equipped with the Cat Claw and magic.

evidence.quote: Here you'll meet your next ally, Phoebe. She comes equipped with the Cat Claw and a larger variety of magic then your previous allies.

subject: Cat Claw
text: Phoebe gives you the Cat Claw, which can be used to climb textured walls in dungeons.

evidence.quote: Phoebe will give you the Cat Claw. Claws can be used to climb the textured walls you see throughout dungeons going forward.

subject: Squidite
text: Defeating the Squidite at the end of Wintry Cave awards the Libra Crest, used to teleport on tiles with the same symbol.

evidence.quote: Upon reaching the end of the dungeon you will find and fight the Squidite and receive the Libra Crest you came here for. These crests can be used to teleport by stepping on a tile with the same symbol.
